description: Defines the internal class DittoDuration for representing and parsing durations with positive amounts, including methods for creation from Duration objects or string representations, and internal enum for time units.

classes.name: DittoDuration
classes.description: Immutable class representing a positive duration with parsing and conversion capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a Java Duration, ensuring it is not null or negative.

methods.name: parseDuration
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a duration into a DittoDuration, with support for suffixes.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration as a Java Duration object.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the duration length is zero.
